architecture_finding.summary: No standalone stock_picking_wave module in Odoo 19.0 Community. Wave transfers are stock.picking.batch records with is_wave=True, implemented entirely within stock_picking_batch.

model_fields.name: Char — auto-named via ir.sequence (WAVE/ prefix for waves)
model_fields.is_wave: Boolean — True for wave transfers, False for batch transfers
model_fields.state: Selection [draft, in_progress, done, cancel] — stored, computed
model_fields.move_ids: One2many (computed) — aggregated moves from all pickings

transitions.any_to_done: _compute_state(): all pickings in (cancel, done) with ≥1 done
transitions.any_to_cancel: _compute_state(): all pickings cancelled; OR action_cancel() explicit

state_machine.note: Records already in done or cancel are excluded from _compute_state() recomputation

wave_creation.manual_wizard: stock.add.to.wave transient model; wizard calls line_ids._add_to_wave(wave_id)
wave_creation.picking_split: If partial lines selected from a picking, source picking is split via copy_data + move._split(qty)
wave_creation.whole_picking: If all lines of a picking selected, picking linked directly via Command.link
wave_creation.auto_confirm: batch_auto_confirm on picking_type triggers wave.action_confirm() after adding lines

eligibility_conditions: not already in a wave (batch_id.is_wave == False)
picking_type.auto_batch == True AND at least one wave grouping key enabled

grouping_keys.wave_group_by_category: Group by product category (filtered by wave_category_ids)
grouping_keys.wave_group_by_location: Group by nearest ancestor wave location (from wave_location_ids)

flow: 2. _auto_wave_lines_into_existing_waves(): match to open waves respecting grouping keys and size limits
3. _auto_wave_lines_into_new_waves(): create new waves for unmatched lines, sort by (picking_id, move_id) to minimize splits

behaviour: Detaches empty/waiting pickings from wave (does not cancel them)
Context batches_to_validate prevents re-targeting current wave during backorder auto-wave

assign_action.behaviour: Calls picking_ids.action_assign() on all member pickings; this propagates to _action_assign() on moves, which triggers _auto_wave() on resulting move lines

batch_vs_wave.merge_restriction: Batch and wave records cannot be merged with each other (UserError in action_merge)

barcode_integration.enterprise: Available (stock_barcode module — not in this source tree)

migration_notes.key_risk: Picking split logic in _add_to_wave() creates new pickings on partial line selection; customisations that assume 1-to-1 picking-to-wave must account for this
migration_notes.enterprise_gap: Barcode wave scanning not available in Community; any workflow relying on barcode wave validation requires Enterprise or custom module
migration_notes.auto_wave_dependency: Auto-wave fires only when stock.picking.type.auto_batch=True AND wave grouping keys configured; must configure operation types correctly post-migration
migration_notes.no_separate_model: Any code referencing a hypothetical stock.picking.wave model will fail; correct model is stock.picking.batch with is_wave=True domain filter
